description: Preference for foundation designs that do not require pile driving.
context_quote: The agencies are committed to working with lessees to develop standards for determining where it would be preferred to use foundation designs that do not rely on pile driving (e.g., gravity-based foundations)

description: Sound fields generated during impact pile driving should not exceed NOAA Fisheries’ Level A permanent threshold shift (PTS) limits for low frequency cetaceans (LFC) at distances greater than 1,000 meters from each foundation.
context_quote: Sound fields generated during impact pile driving should be reduced to the maximum extent practicable with a goal of not exceeding NOAA Fisheries’ Level A permanent threshold shift (PTS) limits for low frequency cetaceans (LFC) at distances greater than 1,000 meters from each foundation.

description: Vessels should slow to 10 knots or less when North Atlantic right whales (NARWs) may be present or when visibility is poor.
geographic_scope: Areas where NARWs may be present
context_quote: All vessels should have a dedicated lookout or PSO watching for NARWs at all times and slow to 10 knots or less at any time/location that NARWs may be present and at any time when visibility is poor.

description: Project schedules should avoid installing foundations during times when NARWs are most likely to occur in lease areas and along vessel routes.
context_quote: Project schedules should avoid installing foundations during the time of year when NARWs are most likely to occur in the lease areas and along vessel routes, including known areas of higher NARW density and persistence, and including, but not limited to, Nantucket Shoals, Cape Cod Bay, calving grounds, and designated NARW critical habitat.

description: Baseline data collection on NARW presence should cover at least 3 years prior to environmental review.
context_quote: Ensure all environmental reviews are informed by baseline data on the use of the project area by NARWs, to include at least 3 years of baseline data.

description: Post-construction monitoring of NARW presence and habitat use should continue for at least 3 years.
context_quote: Implement continued monitoring during the construction period and for at least 3 years post construction to assess impact of the project on NARWs and their habitat.
